subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the underlined word in the given sentence.

Such specifications have __revived__ our designers and manufacturers, whereas this new arrangement will free them.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (restrain)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"revived"** means to bring back to life, consciousness, or activity; to renew or make active again. (पुनर्जीवित करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The company was **revived** after a major restructuring effort.
 
 
 
• **"Restrain"** refers to holding back, controlling, or limiting someone or something from action or movement. (नियंत्रित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher had to **restrain** the students from running in the hallway.
 
 
 
• Since "restrain" is the opposite of "revived" in the context of limiting or holding back versus renewing or activating, the correct antonym is **Option 1 (restrain)**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (restrain)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Senior** (वरिष्ठ): Refers to a person of higher rank or age.

 
 
• **Example:** She consulted her **senior** manager for advice on the project.
 
 
 
• **Swatted** (मारा): Refers to hitting or slapping something, especially a fly or insect.
 
 
• **Example:** He **swatted** the mosquito that was buzzing around his ear.
 
 
 
• **Productive** (उत्पादक): Refers to being efficient, producing good results, or generating output.
 
 
• **Example:** The team had a **productive** meeting and came up with great ideas.
